limitations: Reporting-manager CIK is not a held-company issuer CIK. No connection to the company research queue or a security is inferred.
One June–August2026 filing batch is not complete manager history or current positions. Report periods can be much older than filing dates; multiple filings may amend one period.
Amendments, restatements, new-holdings and notice forms remain separate source records. Blank flags are not independent evidence of no amendment or confidentiality; flags are not reconciled.
No holding values, shares, CUSIPs, manager names, addresses, signatures or personal contacts are published. No position changes, purchases/sales, exposure, returns or strategy are reconstructed.
An absent manager means no submission in this retained batch, not no manager, no holdings or no activity. Links are constructed accession lookups, not verified originals.
search_scope: Exact normalized manager CIK or literal prefix of unpadded numeric manager CIK only. No name, ticker, company or security resolution. An absent CIK is absent from this batch, not no holdings.
selection: Every reporting-manager CIK and submission in this one retained filing batch; no held-issuer or security join.
sharding: lowercase hexadecimal of numeric CIK modulo 16; fixed shard-{bucket}.json
